in_hindi.name: रावि-सिंघ
in_hindi.meaning: रात्रि के अनदेशी सूर्य (Sun away from the night)
in_hindi.long_meaning: Radiant and Courageous, like a lion, one who is away from the night (symbolizing one who is successful and has overcome challenges)

in_marathi.name: Raysingh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Raysingh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Raja meaning king, Singha meaning lion, Raysingh is the name of a brave and powerful monarch, who rules over his kingdom with the grace and might of the sun.

in_bengali.name: Raysingh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Sun King
in_bengali.long_meaning: Raysingh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Raja meaning king, Singha meaning lion, Raysingh is the name of a brave and powerful monarch, who rules over his kingdom with the grace and might of the sun.
